import collections
def dots(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    c = collections.Counter(((r-12)//6,(c2-11)//6) for r in range(12,64) for c2 in range(11,64) if a[r][c2]=='N')

    g = collections.Counter(((r-12)//6,(c2-11)//6) for r in range(1,64) for c2 in range(64) if a[r][c2]=='g')
    return dict(G), dict(g)
